title: Back to Basics Prep
subtitle: Foundational contracting cert (70% to pass)
description: A structured prep journey for the contracting Back to Basics test. Move through topic stages at your own pace — study the material, then test yourself. Cap it off with a practice exam to gauge your readiness.

stages.title: FAR Foundations
stages.description: The FAR System framework, definitions, and key conventions every contracting professional must know.

stages.title: Ethics & Improper Practices
stages.description: Standards of conduct, gratuities, procurement integrity, and conflicts of interest.

stages.title: Pre-Award Planning
stages.description: Publicizing actions, competition requirements, acquisition planning, and required sources of supply.

stages.title: Source Selection & Award
stages.description: Contractor qualifications, market research, requirements, sealed bidding, and contracting by negotiation.

stages.title: Procurement Methods
stages.description: Commercial products and services, contract types, and service contracting.

stages.title: Small Business
stages.description: Small business programs, set-asides, and socioeconomic requirements.

stages.title: Contract Administration & Closeout
stages.description: Contract administration, modifications, quality assurance, and termination of contracts.
